Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.06.26.6:

- New 'FDC + DSPM Agent' page in Product Lifecycle. The Classification Agent and the DSPM Agent are the same binary, so both now read their version, GA and EoSale/EoM/EoSupport from this single shared lifecycle category in Version & EoS.
- Classification Server continues to resolve from the Forcepoint Data Classification (FDC) page, and DSPM Server from the Forcepoint DSPM page.
- Any row with no matching lifecycle entry stays fully editable via the row's Edit override.

For more details, please refer to the official documentation or contact support.
